worker_output.summary: Created src/data/starting-fleets.json with starting ship designs and fleet compositions for all 10 races. Each race has 3 ship designs (colony, scout/utility, combat) and a starting fleet of 5-7 ships. Colony ships are included for every race. All ship designs use only each race's starting technologies from races.json. Notable design decisions: Rabbits get 2 colony ships (matching exponential_growth + expansion playstyle); Chameleons have cloaking_device on scouts (it's a starting tech — massive early intelligence advantage); Budgies use ion_drives (warp 4) giving the fastest starting fleet; Guinea Pigs start with the strongest pure combat fleet; Ferrets use battle_scanner synergy with first_strike ability; Ants/Guinea Pigs use retro_engines as baseline (no engine in starting techs). All 695 existing tests pass.
